ops.title: Declare required guard packs in pack manifests so a fully failed pack still withholds guard completion
ops.description: Follow-up from PR #264 (TaskStop guard). captain_hook/worker/runtime.py _guard_completion derives the packs whose load errors withhold completion from the mandatory hooks that survived registration plus the always-required general pack. A non-general pack whose mandatory modules all fail to import registers no mandatory hooks, so its load error is ignored and only that plugin's own mandatory policy is lost for the session. TaskStop, the general session guards, and the native transport-failure deny are unaffected. Predates #264; finder artifact: /Users/yasyf/.local/state/cc-remote/setup-20261001/capt-stop-guard-264-feb286e-finder.json

ops.text: Required guard packs are declared in the pack manifest (packs/manager.py descriptor) independently of which modules import; the worker's _guard_completion reads that declaration rather than deriving packs from surviving mandatory registrations.

A load error in a declared guard pack withholds guard completion even when that pack registers no mandatory hooks (every mandatory module failed to import); regression test at the discovery level for both PreToolUse and PermissionRequest.
The general pack stays required independently of its imports (GUARD_PACKS behaviour preserved), and a load error in a pack that declares no guard role keeps being ignored.
